theory: Remove the cylinder formula, radius, diameter and square-root teaching unsupported by this booklet. Correct the claim that finding any side length needs one division: the booklet also asks for cube sides, which require a cube root. Distinguish length answers from cross-sectional-area answers, which use square units, and clarify that the h in V = Ah is the distance between the parallel cross-sections.
summary: Replaced the unsupported cylinder and inverse cross-section-side tasks with cited booklet types, retained all quiz ids and tier counts, and repaired the three specified distractor explanations while preserving unaffected items exactly. Revised the theory to cover prism distances, cross-sectional areas and cube sides with correct units and inverse operations; no whole items were removed.
